findings.detail: Rows flagged by C304 have blank asset_class even though the source schedule classifies the positions as non-controlled, non-affiliated debt investments, which maps to PRIVATE_CREDIT.

rationale: C304 flags blank asset_class on affected holdings rows. The raw SOI places the cited positions under Non-Controlled, Non-Affiliated Debt Investments and First Lien Senior Secured, with individual loan rows such as Amplify Buyer, Inc. Term Loan. That source structure makes the controlled asset_class classifiable as PRIVATE_CREDIT, so the blank observed value is a real extraction/classification defect rather than a false alarm.
